title: LOOKUPVALUE returns the result column of the row matching one search value, and BLANK when no row matches

source.quote: LOOKUPVALUE searches a table for the value of a column, given a set of values for other columns in the same table
source.supports: LOOKUPVALUE searches for the row with the given value

source.quote: If no match satisfies all the search values, the function returns BLANK or alternateResult (if specified)
If there is no match that satisfies all the search values, a BLANK is returned

derivation: ProductKey 3 is Lock. No Product row has ProductKey 99: BLANK.
